div.div: جَنْدَلٌ (S, K) and جَنْدِلٌ (K) Stones; (S in art. جدل;) used in the sense of [the pl.] جَنَادِلُ: (Sb, TA:) n. un. جَنْدَلَةٌ: (TA:) or what a man can lift, of stones: (K:) or, as some say, any stone: (TA:) or a mass of stone like a man's head. (T, TA.) [Hence, تُرْبًا لَهُ وَجَنْدَلًا: see تُرَابٌ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
